name: Describe an everyday object clearly
short_description: Describe an everyday object clearly once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can describe an everyday object clearly in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Describe an everyday object clearly means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Describe an everyday object clearly in a fresh real-life scenario.

builds_on.note: Match a written label to an object helps develop describe a familiar object clearly but is not indispensable.
